question: The supply closet at Lincoln Elementary held 154 pencils at the start of the term. A donation drive added 24 more pencils to the closet. A bulk order then turned every pencil in the closet into 7 pencils, delivered in a shipment the janitor said took '120 minutes, or two full hours' to unload. The PTA then donated 39 more pencils. Finally, 266 pencils were handed out to classrooms for a school-wide art project. How many pencils were left in the supply closet after the pencils were handed out?

A toy store had 142 yo-yos in stock at the start of the month. A new shipment brought in 9 more yo-yos. A defective batch of 44 yo-yos had to be returned to the manufacturer. A second shipment then added 62 more yo-yos to the shelf. A big weekend sale moved 117 yo-yos out the door. Afterward, a wholesale deal turned every remaining yo-yo into 9 yo-yos, a deal that closed in what the manager called '60 minutes, or a single hour.' How many yo-yos were in stock after the wholesale deal?

Lily had 47 seashells in her bucket after a morning at the beach, while her brother Sam had found only 19 seashells in his own bucket. Lily gave 12 seashells to a tide-pool tour guide as a thank-you. She then dropped 3 shells while climbing over some rocks. A sudden wave swept away 27 more shells before she could grab them. She accidentally left 2 shells behind on a picnic table that also held a stack of 15 napkins nobody touched. That evening, a shell-crafting kit turned every shell she still had into 9 polished shells. How many polished shells did Lily end up with?

In the morning, a flower shop had 135 roses in the cooler. A wholesale delivery turned every rose into 9 fresh roses to restock for a big wedding order. By afternoon, 148 roses were used for wedding centerpieces. Later that afternoon, 44 more roses were sold to walk-in customers. That evening, a large corporate event order took 802 roses all at once. Right before closing, a supplier dropped off 34 more roses for the next day. How many roses were in the cooler after the supplier's evening drop-off?

In the morning, Nadia had 212 trading stamps in her booklet, while her friend Owen had 95 stamps in his. By midday, Nadia used 18 stamps to redeem a small prize. In the afternoon, she spent 82 more stamps on a gift for her mom. That evening, she earned 29 more stamps from a bonus promotion. Right before the store closed, she lost 1 stamp that fell out of her booklet. A final loyalty bonus then turned every stamp she had left into 5 stamps. How many stamps did Nadia have after the loyalty bonus?

In the morning, a classroom had 192 sticks of chalk in the supply drawer. By midday, 105 sticks had been used across three classes. In the afternoon, 3 more sticks broke and were tossed out. The teacher mentioned a dozen new whiteboard markers were on order, though they hadn't arrived and had nothing to do with the chalk. That evening, 5 more sticks were used for an after-school tutoring session. Right before locking up, a supply closet restock turned every remaining stick into 7 sticks. How many sticks of chalk were in the drawer after the restock?

In the morning, a food bank had 226 cans of vegetables in storage. By midday, a grocery store donated 51 more cans, and in the afternoon a school food drive added 38 more. A volunteer mentioned a dozen loaves of bread had also come in, though bread wasn't part of the can count. That evening, 159 cans were distributed to families in need, and later that night 118 more cans went to a shelter across town. Right before closing, a corporate donor gave 64 more cans, and a matching program then turned every can into 5 cans. How many cans of vegetables did the food bank have after the matching program?

A candy factory produced 125 boxes of chocolates in a single batch. The factory manager noted that 20 broken machines needed repair, but that had nothing to do with the box count. A retooled line then turned every box into 9 boxes. A shipping error caused 776 boxes to be lost in transit. A make-good shipment then added 57 more boxes. A final bonus shipment, which the driver said took '120 minutes, or two hours' to deliver, added 66 more boxes. How many boxes of chocolates were there after the final bonus shipment?

In the morning, Elena had $169 saved for a new bicycle, while her brother Theo had $85 saved for a skateboard. By midday, Elena spent $98 on bike accessories she needed first. That afternoon, a summer job bonus turned every dollar she had left into 7 dollars. In the evening, she earned $37 more from babysitting. Right before the bike shop closed, a loyalty discount turned every dollar into 9 dollars in store credit. How much store credit did Elena have after the loyalty discount was applied?

Nina had 109 buttons in her sewing kit, while her sister Zoe had 200 buttons in her own kit. Nina used 64 buttons to finish a quilt project. A craft fair swap then turned every button she had left into 8 buttons, and a vendor's bulk trade turned each of those into 7 buttons. A second vendor's trade turned every button into 6 buttons, and her button count then doubled when a fabric shop offered a matching promotion. Finally, a closing sale turned every button into 3 buttons. How many buttons did Nina have after the closing sale?

A pastry chef prepared 45 croissants for the morning batch. A second oven turned every croissant into 2 croissants for a catering order. The chef then split the croissants evenly among 6 delivery boxes and kept only one box for the shop display. A supplier delivered 58 more croissants for the afternoon rush, a delivery that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to arrive. A dessert festival order then turned every croissant into 8 croissants, and a final wholesale order turned each of those into 9 croissants. How many croissants were there after the final wholesale order?

In the morning, a beekeeper had 176 jars of honey ready for sale. By midday, 26 more jars were filled from the second hive. In the afternoon, 65 more jars came from a third hive. That evening, a big honey festival order turned every jar into 4 jars for a bulk sale. Right after that, a farmers' market added 49 more jars to the stock. Before the day ended, a neighboring beekeeper contributed 48 more jars. How many jars of honey did the beekeeper have at the end of the day?

A movie theater had 212 bags of popcorn in stock before the weekend rush. A vendor restocked with 48 more bags. During the first showing, 45 bags were sold. The manager mentioned a dozen soda cups had also been restocked, though that had nothing to do with popcorn. During the second showing, 104 bags were sold. During the third showing, 76 more bags were sold. After the last showing, 11 more bags were sold to a late-night crowd. How many bags of popcorn were left after the late-night crowd?

In the morning, a toy drive had 118 stuffed animals collected. By midday, 87 stuffed animals were donated to a children's hospital. In the afternoon, a local business donated 54 more stuffed animals. That evening, 58 stuffed animals were sent to a shelter. Right after that, the remaining stuffed animals tripled when a toy company matched the donation drive. Before the night was over, 25 more were given to a school event, and 18 more went to a family shelter downtown. How many stuffed animals were left after the family shelter donation?

A school's recycling club collected 21 pounds of cans in the first week. The club advisor mentioned that 15 pounds of paper had also been recycled, but that was tracked separately from the cans. In the second week, the club collected 28 more pounds of cans. In the third week, they collected 51 more pounds. A regional recycling contest then turned every pound of cans into 6 pounds worth of credit. A bonus multiplier from the contest sponsor turned every pound of credit into 3 pounds. How many pounds of credit did the recycling club end up with?

Priyanka had 124 trading cards in her deck-building collection, while her rival Sam had 300 cards in his. A convention trade turned every card she had into 5 cards. A second trade turned each of those into 7 cards. A tournament entry fee cost her 1075 cards. A rare misprint recall then took away 2077 more cards. A bonus round afterward turned every remaining card into 2 cards. How many cards did Priyanka have after the bonus round?

In the morning, a bakery had 203 loaves of bread on the shelf. By midday, 13 loaves were sold to a local cafe. In the afternoon, 157 more loaves were sold during the lunch rush. That evening, a delivery brought in 67 more loaves. Right after, another batch added 32 more loaves fresh from the oven. A wholesale client then turned every loaf into 7 loaves for a large event order, but the client only picked up a portion, so the bakery split the loaves evenly into 3 equal batches and kept just one batch on the shelf. How many loaves of bread were left on the shelf?

A community garden had 70 sunflowers blooming in June. A strong wind knocked down 2 of them beyond recovery. A group of deer wandered through and trampled 19 more. A local nursery then donated 71 more sunflower plants to replace the losses. The gardeners split the sunflowers evenly into 3 equal garden beds and kept track of just one bed for the fall display. A late-season bloom then added 13 more sunflowers to that bed. How many sunflowers were in that garden bed by the end of the season?

A comic book warehouse had 149 crates of comics ready for distribution. The manager mentioned that a dozen forklifts were being serviced that week, though that had nothing to do with the crate count. A regional recall required sending back 26 crates to the printer. A restocking order then turned every crate into 6 crates. A second restocking order turned each of those into 9 crates. A final bulk order turned every crate into 6 more crates. How many crates of comics were in the warehouse after the final bulk order?

A stamp collector named Felix had 88 rare stamps in his album, while his rival Wendy had 210 stamps in hers. A dealer's trade turned every stamp Felix had into 3 stamps, and a second trade turned each of those into 9 stamps. Felix mentioned that a nearby shop had 500 postcards for sale, though he didn't buy any of them. A tax on the trade required him to give up 2242 stamps, and he then lost 9 more stamps that got damaged in the mail. Finally, he received 43 more stamps from a swap meet. How many stamps did Felix have after the swap meet?

Diego had $63 saved from his paper route at the start of summer. He earned $73 more from mowing lawns. His savings then tripled when his parents matched his summer earnings as a reward. He spent $345 on a new mountain bike, a purchase that took '60 minutes, or one hour' of haggling at the shop. Finally, a birthday gift turned every dollar he had left into 3 dollars. How much money did Diego have after the birthday gift?

A warehouse had 159 pallets of bottled water before a heat wave hit. A delivery service note mentioned that 40 trucks were being repaired, but that had nothing to do with the pallet count. A rush restocking order turned every pallet into 8 pallets. A large grocery chain then bought 801 pallets in one order, and a second grocery chain bought 221 more pallets. A statewide emergency order then turned every remaining pallet into 5 pallets, and a final relief shipment turned each of those into 4 pallets. How many pallets of bottled water were left after the final relief shipment?

A toy store had 187 building-block sets in stock before the holidays. A big sale moved 78 sets out the door in one weekend. A restock order then turned every remaining set into 9 sets. A late shipment added 14 more sets, arriving after a drive that took '120 minutes, or two hours.' A holiday rush then sold 584 sets in a single week. A final clearance event turned every remaining set into 5 sets. How many building-block sets were left after the clearance event?

A youth soccer team had 79 trophies displayed in the school case at the start of the season. A shelf mishap caused 2 trophies to be removed for repair. The team then won 38 more trophies over the season, including finals that spanned '180 minutes, or three hours' of total play time. The coach mentioned a dozen jerseys also needed replacing, though that had nothing to do with the trophy count. The trophies were then split evenly among 5 school display cases, with only the main case being tracked from then on. That main case gained 62 more trophies after the championship win. How many trophies were in the main display case after the championship win?

In the morning, a movie theater had 141 rolls of tickets in the box office. By midday, 6 rolls were sent to a sister theater across town, and in the afternoon a big premiere event turned every roll into 5 rolls to meet demand. The manager mentioned that 200 popcorn buckets were also delivered that day, though that had nothing to do with the ticket rolls. That evening, 33 more rolls arrived from the printer, and right before the late show, 32 more rolls were delivered. After the last screening, 657 rolls were used up for the sold-out night. How many rolls of tickets were left after the sold-out night?
